mapper.select: SELECT d.sale_date, SUM(d.order_count) AS order_count, SUM(d.sales_amount) AS sales_amount, SUM(d.cancel_amount) AS cancel_amount FROM ( SELECT DATE(p.approved_at) AS sale_date, 1 AS order_count, p.amount AS sales_amount, 0 AS cancel_amount FROM payment p WHERE p.status IN ('DONE', 'CANCELED') AND p.approved_at >= #{fromAt} AND p.approved_at < #{toExclusiveAt} UNION ALL SELECT DATE(p.canceled_at), 0, 0, p.amount FROM payment p WHERE p.status = 'CANCELED' AND p.canceled_at >= #{fromAt} AND p.canceled_at < #{toExclusiveAt} ) d GROUP BY d.sale_date ORDER BY d.sale_date

SELECT pr.id, pr.title, a.name AS artist_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_quantity, SUM(oi.price_snapshot * oi.quantity) AS sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.id JOIN product pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id JOIN artist a ON a.id = pr.artist_id WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'PREPARING', 'SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED') AND p.approved_at >= #{fromAt} AND p.approved_at < #{toExclusiveAt} GROUP BY pr.id, pr.title, a.name
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC, sold_quantity DESC, pr.id DESC
ORDER BY sold_quantity DESC, sales_amount DESC, pr.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ld.id, pr.title, ld.status, ld.total_quantity, ld.sold_count, ROUND(ld.sold_count * 100 / ld.total_quantity, 1) AS sell_rate, ld.open_at, ld.close_at, CASE WHEN ld.status = 'SOLD_OUT' THEN (SELECT MAX(lp.created_at) FROM limited_purchase lp WHERE lp.drop_id = ld.id) END AS sold_out_at, CASE WHEN ld.status = 'SOLD_OUT' THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ld.open_at, (SELECT MAX(lp.created_at) FROM limited_purchase lp WHERE lp.drop_id = ld.id)) END AS sold_out_seconds FROM limited_drop ld JOIN product pr ON pr.id = ld.product_id ORDER BY ld.open_at DESC, ld.id DESC

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payment p WHERE p.status IN ('DONE', 'CANCELED') AND p.approved_at >= #{todayStart} AND p.approved_at < #{tomorrowStart}), 0) AS today_sales_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.status IN ('DONE', 'CANCELED') AND p.approved_at >= #{todayStart} AND p.approved_at < #{tomorrowStart}) AS today_order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m WHERE m.created_at >= #{todayStart} AND m.created_at < #{tomorrowStart}) AS today_new_member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'PENDING') AS pending_order_count
